rate_limits: For small requests (e.g. up to 7–14 days for a single site): max 5–10 requests/sec steady; brief bursts of 40–50 requests/sec OK but not sustained. Excessive use may be blocked (HTTP 403).
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor right. Official General Questions publishes 5–10 req/s steady and 40–50 burst guidance; excess may be blocked. https://waterservices.usgs.gov/docs/general/ status: original operational stands (not defunct); auditor right that early-2027 decommission is material—homepage + blog: Q1 2027 shutdown, migrate to https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov (migration guide). https://waterservices.usgs.gov/ https://waterdata.usgs.gov/blog/api-waterservices-decom/
